summary: A 19-year-old employee at a McDonald's in Springtown, Texas allegedly took customers' legitimate card payments and then tapped their cards again on his own device, creating fraudulent $10-$20 charges to an account he controlled. Police counted more than 50 fraudulent charges totalling about $680 and arrested him in January 2026.
